answer: New identities join a bridge inspection roster. An applicant claims one footbridge, pays 25 dollars, and files four weekly photo sets over 28 days of a deck joint and a support bolt, each stamped with time and place. Two inspectors check each set; a mismatch or a false photo forfeits the fee and blocks that bridge for 180 days. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 bridges and 25,000 dollars. Like the sparrow in a fable that crossed the bridge at dawn until the keeper knew its shadow, an applicant becomes known only by returning week after week. Miss two checks and the slot closes.
